tips-bol: Bond of Life is a mechanic that **absorbs any healing** a character receives. It appears as a **red outline around their HP bar**, and its maximum value is 200% of the character's HP (represented by an outline around the entire HP bar). To clear a Bond of Life, the character must **receive healing equal to its value**.
tips-ssw: When Stellar Swirl is triggered, a Stellar Vortex is created. These vortexes explode after a short time. The **more times Stellar Swirl is triggered**, the **higher the explosion DMG** of the vortex.
